title: Amazing Spider-Man
description: Peter Parker balances his life as a teenager with his secret identity as Spider-Man, fighting villains in New York City while dealing with personal struggles.

title: Batman
description: Bruce Wayne, the Dark Knight, protects Gotham City from its criminal underworld using his intellect, martial arts skills, and an arsenal of high-tech gadgets.

title: X-Men
description: A team of mutants led by Professor X fights for peaceful coexistence between mutants and humans while battling Magneto and other threats.

title: Superman
description: The Man of Steel, Clark Kent, protects Metropolis and the world as Superman, the last son of Krypton with incredible powers.

title: Avengers
description: Earth's Mightiest Heroes unite to face threats no single hero can handle alone, from alien invasions to cosmic catastrophes.

title: Wonder Woman
description: Diana Prince, Princess of Themyscira, fights for justice and equality as Wonder Woman, one of the most powerful beings on Earth.

title: The Flash
description: Barry Allen, the fastest man alive, protects Central City using his super-speed abilities while navigating the timestream.

title: Iron Man
description: Genius billionaire Tony Stark suits up as Iron Man to protect the world from threats both technological and supernatural.

title: Captain America
description: Steve Rogers, the Super-Soldier, fights for the American ideals of freedom and justice as the star-spangled Avenger.

title: The Walking Dead
description: Sheriff Rick Grimes awakens from a coma to find the world overrun by zombies and leads a group of survivors through the apocalypse.

title: Invincible
description: Teenager Mark Grayson inherits his father's superpowers and becomes the hero Invincible, discovering dark secrets about his Viltrumite heritage.

title: Green Lantern
description: Hal Jordan, chosen by the Guardians of the Universe, wields the most powerful weapon in the cosmos.

title: Deadpool
description: The Merc with a Mouth breaks the fourth wall as Wade Wilson, an irreverent anti-hero with an incredible healing factor.

title: Aquaman
description: Arthur Curry, King of Atlantis, rules the underwater kingdom while defending both the ocean and the surface world from threats.

title: Wolverine
description: Logan, the mutant with an adamantium skeleton and healing factor, is the best there is at what he does.

title: Watchmen
description: In an alternate 1985 where superheroes are real and feared, a group of retired heroes investigate a murder that threatens to destroy the world.

title: Hellboy
description: A demon summoned by Nazis who becomes a paranormal investigator for the B.P.R.D., fighting occult threats with his giant stone hand.

title: Saga
description: Alana and Marko, soldiers from warring alien races, fall in love and flee across the universe with their newborn daughter.

title: The Sandman
description: Dream of the Endless, the lord of dreams, escapes decades of captivity and must reclaim his lost kingdom while exploring the nature of stories.

title: Daredevil
description: Blind lawyer Matt Murdock uses his heightened senses to fight crime as Daredevil, protecting Hell's Kitchen from the criminal underworld.

title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
description: Four mutant turtles trained in ninjutsu by Master Splinter fight crime in New York City while battling the Foot Clan and Shredder.

title: Spawn
description: Al Simmons makes a deal with the devil and returns to Earth as Spawn, a hellspawn with incredible powers waging war on evil.

title: The Boys
description: A CIA black-ops team is tasked with keeping watch on the superhero community, using any means necessary to keep them in check.

title: Thor
description: The God of Thunder wields the enchanted hammer Mjolnir, defending Asgard and the Nine Realms from cosmic threats.

title: Green Arrow
description: Billionaire Oliver Queen fights for justice as the Emerald Archer, using his archery skills and wits to protect Star City.

title: Punisher
description: Frank Castle wages a one-man war on crime after his family is murdered, using military skills and an arsenal of weapons.

title: Justice League
description: The World's Greatest Superheroes unite to defend Earth from threats beyond any single hero's power.

title: Sin City
description: Frank Miller's noir masterpiece set in Basin City, where corrupt cops, femme fatales, and desperate men cross paths in violent tales.

title: Nightwing
description: Dick Grayson, the original Robin, steps out of Batman's shadow to become Nightwing, protecting Bludhaven with his own style.

title: Fantastic Four
description: The First Family of Marvel explores the cosmos and faces fantastic threats beyond imagination.

title: Harley Quinn
description: The former psychiatrist turned Joker's accomplice strikes out on her own as an unpredictable anti-heroine in Gotham City.

title: Venom
description: Eddie Brock bonds with the alien symbiote Venom, becoming a lethal protector who must balance the creature's hunger with his own morals.

title: Guardians of the Galaxy
description: A ragtag group of cosmic misfits save the galaxy while bickering constantly — Star-Lord, Gamora, Drax, Rocket, and Groot.

title: Umbrella Academy
description: A dysfunctional family of adopted siblings with extraordinary powers must reunite to prevent the apocalypse.

title: Teen Titans
description: The next generation of heroes led by Robin forms a team to fight evil while learning to work together and grow up.

title: Doctor Strange
description: Dr. Stephen Strange, the Sorcerer Supreme, protects Earth from mystical and magical threats using his mastery of the arcane arts.

title: Moon Knight
description: Marc Spector, a mercenary resurrected by the Egyptian moon god Khonshu, fights crime as the vigilante Moon Knight.

title: Ghost Rider
description: Johnny Blaze sells his soul and becomes Ghost Rider, the Spirit of Vengeance, riding a flaming motorcycle and wielding hellfire chains.

title: V for Vendetta
description: In a totalitarian future Britain, a masked anarchist named V wages a guerrilla campaign against the fascist government.

title: Black Panther
description: T'Challa, King of Wakanda, protects his technologically advanced African nation as the Black Panther.

title: Supergirl
description: Kara Zor-El, Superman's cousin, adjusts to life on Earth while embracing her destiny as the Maid of Might.

title: Batgirl
description: Barbara Gordon, daughter of Commissioner Gordon, fights crime as Batgirl using her martial arts skills and technical genius.

title: Locke & Key
description: The Locke family discovers magical keys in their ancestral home that grant extraordinary powers while a demon seeks them.

title: Ms. Marvel
description: Kamala Khan, a Pakistani-American teenager from Jersey City, gains shape-shifting powers and becomes the new Ms. Marvel.

title: Rat Queens
description: A foul-mouthed group of mercenary queens go on adventures filled with magic and mayhem.

title: Deadly Class
description: A teenager recruited into a secret academy for assassins struggles to survive the deadly curriculum and his own inner demons.

title: Ant-Man
description: Scott Lang, a reformed thief, uses Hank Pym's shrinking suit to become Ant-Man, pulling off impossible heists at miniature scale.

title: Transformers
description: The Autobots and Decepticons bring their ancient war to Earth, with the fate of both planets hanging in the balance.

title: B.P.R.D.
description: The Bureau for Paranormal Research and Defense investigates occult threats worldwide, expanding beyond Hellboy's solo adventures.

title: Immortal Hulk
description: Bruce Banner transforms into the incredible Hulk when angry, a gamma-powered juggernaut caught between science and rage.

title: Constantine
description: John Constantine, a cynical con-man and occult detective, battles demons and angels in a world of dark magic and divine corruption.

title: G.I. Joe
description: The elite military strike force battles the terrorist organization Cobra to protect freedom worldwide.

title: Bone
description: Three bone cousins are run out of Boneville and find themselves in a mysterious valley filled with dragons, monsters, and adventure.

title: The Joker
description: The Clown Prince of Crime gets his own series, exploring the chaotic and terrifying mind of Batman's greatest nemesis.

title: Black Widow
description: Natasha Romanoff, the former Soviet spy turned Avenger, uses her espionage skills to complete dangerous missions around the globe.

title: Silver Surfer
description: Norrin Radd, the herald of Galactus, soars through the cosmos on his silver board, seeking redemption for the worlds he helped destroy.

title: Preacher
description: Jesse Custer, a small-town preacher possessed by a celestial entity, hits the road to find God with his ex-girlfriend and a vampire.

title: Y: The Last Man
description: After a mysterious plague kills every male mammal on Earth, Yorick Brown and his pet monkey Ampersand may be the last males alive.

title: 100 Bullets
description: Agent Graves offers ordinary people 100 untraceable bullets and proof of who wronged them, letting them decide whether to seek revenge.

title: Planetary
description: A team of mystery archaeologists investigates the secret history of the 20th century, uncovering the world's hidden mythology.

title: The Dark Knight Returns
description: An aging Bruce Wayne comes out of retirement to fight crime one last time in a dystopian Gotham City ruled by mutants.

title: All-Star Superman
description: Grant Morrison's masterpiece where Superman faces his greatest challenge after being overdosed with solar radiation.

title: Old Man Logan
description: In a world where villains won, an aging Wolverine lives a peaceful life until forced on a cross-country journey through a wasteland America.

title: Civil War
description: The superhero community is torn apart when the government mandates registration, pitting Iron Man against Captain America.

title: Kingdom Come
description: In a future where brutal new heroes have replaced the classics, an aging Superman must decide the world's fate.

title: Marvels
description: Photojournalist Phil Sheldon documents the rise of Marvel superheroes from a normal human's perspective in 1940s New York.

title: Sinestro Corps War
description: The Green Lantern Corps faces its greatest threat when Sinestro raises an army of fear-powered ring bearers.

title: Batman: Year One
description: Frank Miller's definitive origin story of Batman, following Bruce Wayne's first year as a vigilante in corrupt Gotham City.

title: The Killing Joke
description: The Joker escapes Arkham Asylum and paralyzes Barbara Gordon, pushing Batman to his limits in this iconic graphic novel.

title: Spider-Man: Blue
description: Peter Parker reflects on his relationship with Gwen Stacy through a series of audio tapes, blending nostalgia with superhero action.

title: Infinity Gauntlet
description: Thanos collects all six Infinity Stones and becomes virtually omnipotent, forcing Marvel's heroes into a desperate battle for reality.

title: Flashpoint
description: When the Flash alters the timeline, he wakes up in a darker world where Thomas Wayne is Batman and war rages between Atlantis and Themyscira.

title: House of M
description: The Scarlet Witch rewrites reality, creating a world where mutants rule and Magneto is king, with devastating consequences.

title: Batman: Hush
description: A mysterious bandaged figure called Hush manipulates Batman's rogues gallery in an elaborate plot to destroy the Dark Knight.

title: Superman: Red Son
description: What if Superman landed in the Soviet Union instead of Kansas? An alternate history where the Man of Steel becomes a Soviet champion.

title: Star Wars
description: The galaxy far, far away continues in comic form, exploring new stories set between and around the iconic films.

title: Stranger Things
description: The kids of Hawkins, Indiana face supernatural threats from the Upside Down in comic adaptations of the hit Netflix series.

title: Power Rangers
description: The Mighty Morphin Power Rangers face new threats as the legendary Shattered Grid event changes the course of Ranger history.

title: Red Sonja
description: The She-Devil with a Sword battles evil across the Hyborian Age, wielding her legendary blade with unmatched ferocity.

title: Conan the Barbarian
description: The legendary Cimmerian warrior wanders the ancient world, battling sorcerers, monsters, and rival kingdoms.

title: Alien
description: The crew of a spaceship faces the ultimate nightmare in deep space — a xenomorph with acid blood and no weaknesses.

title: Predator
description: The most dangerous hunters in the universe stalk their prey across Earth and beyond, targeting the galaxy's greatest warriors.

title: Concrete
description: A man transformed into a living stone creature becomes a government operative while seeking to understand his transformation.

title: The Last God
description: Thirty years after a band of heroes defeated the Last God, their children must face the entity's return to the world of Pelegrin.

title: Mighty Morphin Power Rangers
description: The original Power Rangers continue their battle against Rita Repulsa's forces in this comic continuation.
